name: Runemaster: a higher Runic Tattoos rank supersedes the lower one (#4208)
contract: Once Runic Tattoos: Earth rank 2 is learned, rank 1 is no longer an active spell, so the client's stance bar shows one Earth tattoo. The superseded rank cannot be cast; the current rank can.

steps.label: The active higher rank must not also apply the lower-rank aura
